nodes.label: AI Ethics Principles
nodes.rationale: Core ethical principles for AI systems: transparency, explainability, accountability, fairness, non-discrimination, privacy, safety, and social justice, as outlined by HP/WebbaCard framework and Polish Ministry of Digitalisation working group

nodes.label: Ethics by Design
nodes.rationale: Design principle requiring ethical values to be embedded from the start of AI system development rather than added as an afterthought

nodes.label: AI Transparency and Explainability
nodes.rationale: Requirement that users understand how AI works and decisions are explainable; includes documenting training data and development process

nodes.label: AI Discrimination Risk
nodes.rationale: Risk that AI systems perpetuate biases from training data, e.g. discriminating in recruitment based on gender or origin

nodes.label: Deepfake and AI Manipulation
nodes.rationale: Ethical challenge involving use of deepfakes for manipulation; absence of clear standards for labelling AI-generated content

nodes.label: AI Governance
nodes.rationale: Organisational policy for managing AI use: ensuring legal compliance, safety, accountability for data, ethical use, and incident response planning

nodes.label: EU AI Act Compliance
nodes.rationale: Legal framework requiring organisations to assess and manage risk in AI deployments to comply with EU AI Act regulation

nodes.label: Privacy Shield (Tarcza Prywatnosci)
nodes.rationale: Feature in Generator GPT tool that scans prompts and files for personal data and potentially confidential information before sending to commercial LLM providers

nodes.label: Synthetic Data for AI Testing
nodes.rationale: Best practice of using synthetic data first to validate AI tool capabilities before processing real confidential data

nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.rationale: Broad field of algorithms that learn from data to identify patterns, predict outcomes, and optimise decisions; parent category encompassing GenAI, NLP, and Computer Vision

nodes.label: Generative AI
nodes.rationale: Subset of machine learning focused on creating new content (text, images, audio, code); examples include GPT, Claude, Gemini

nodes.label: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
nodes.rationale: Specialisation of machine learning focused on language: chatbots, translation, sentiment analysis

nodes.label: Computer Vision
nodes.rationale: Specialisation of machine learning for image and video analysis: facial recognition, medical diagnostics, autonomous vehicles

nodes.label: Supervised Learning
nodes.rationale: ML training method using labelled data with known answers; used for sales/marketing efficiency prediction

nodes.label: Unsupervised Learning
nodes.rationale: ML training method without labels; model finds patterns autonomously; used for clinical trial patient experience analysis

nodes.label: Reinforcement Learning
nodes.rationale: ML method where model learns through trial and error with reward feedback; used for email assistants and recommendation systems

nodes.label: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI)
nodes.rationale: Theoretical AI capable of solving arbitrary problems like humans; being developed by OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Anthropic

nodes.label: LLM Tokens and Cost Model
nodes.rationale: Fundamental unit of LLM processing; Polish text uses more tokens than English; pricing affects model selection for large-scale enterprise deployments

nodes.label: LLM Temperature Parameter
nodes.rationale: Controls creativity vs predictability of model output; low (0.2-0.5) for formal analysis, medium (0.7) for copywriting, high (1.5+) for creative writing

nodes.label: LLM Fine-Tuning
nodes.rationale: Process of further training a base model on domain-specific data (company documents, customer conversations) to specialise it for a particular field

nodes.label: ChatGPT
nodes.rationale: Most popular AI chatbot by OpenAI based on GPT model family; available in free and paid versions via web and mobile

nodes.label: Google Gemini
nodes.rationale: Google's multimodal AI chatbot (formerly Bard), integrated with Google ecosystem; rapid feature release cadence

nodes.label: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.rationale: AI chatbot from Anthropic designed with safety focus and careful content generation; aims for better user intent interpretation

nodes.label: DeepSeek
nodes.rationale: AI chatbot popular in Asia; uses open-source models but has poor privacy policy collecting extensive user device and context data

nodes.label: Generator GPT
nodes.rationale: Proprietary AI wrapper tool with enhanced privacy, multi-model access, agent team building, and privacy shield feature; developed by the course creators

nodes.label: Perplexity AI
nodes.rationale: AI tool specialised in web search and research aggregation; best for finding reliable sources for analysis and reports

nodes.label: LLM Arena
nodes.rationale: Tool for blind comparison testing of AI models; users rate responses without knowing which model produced them; maintains a live leaderboard

nodes.label: Prompt Engineering Basics
nodes.rationale: Four-element prompt structure: Role, Context, Task, Format; covers 80% of everyday use cases when properly applied

nodes.label: Advanced Prompting Techniques
nodes.rationale: Four advanced techniques: analogy technique, constraint technique, SCAMPER technique, and perspective-change technique for better AI output

nodes.label: AI Video Generation Tools
nodes.rationale: Category of AI tools for text-to-video generation: Hailuo AI, Kling AI, RunwayML, and Sora by OpenAI; each with different prompting requirements

nodes.label: Hailuo AI
nodes.rationale: Text-to-video tool with basic (object+scene+action) and precise (adds camera movement+atmosphere) prompt formulas

nodes.label: Kling AI
nodes.rationale: AI video tool strong at dynamic action scenes; supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video extension; prefers simple direct descriptions

nodes.label: RunwayML
nodes.rationale: AI video generation tool used by creators and artists; understands cinematic/photographic terminology; requires image or video input context; supports Motion Brush and negative parameters

nodes.label: Sora (OpenAI)
nodes.rationale: Advanced OpenAI video model available via sora.com; supports multi-minute videos, storyboard editor for sequential shot control, and realistic physics simulation

nodes.label: Suno
nodes.rationale: Advanced music generator creating full songs with vocals, lyrics, and backing track from a text prompt; custom mode for separate lyrics/style input; free version for private use only

nodes.label: Stable Audio
nodes.rationale: Stability AI tool for high-quality instrumental music, loops, and sound effects; tag-list prompt format; trained on licensed music

nodes.label: Beatoven AI
nodes.rationale: Music generator with Fairly Trained certification; uses Maestro model trained exclusively on licensed music; supports mood evolution across segments and commercial license

nodes.label: ElevenLabs
nodes.rationale: Text-to-speech generator with voice cloning (voice design), stability/clarity/expressiveness controls; supports Polish via multilingual V3 model; 10k free chars/month

nodes.label: Proof of Concept (POC)
nodes.rationale: First experimental version of a solution to validate whether an idea has potential before full investment; reduces risk and allows rapid iteration in AI projects

nodes.label: AI Agents
nodes.rationale: Autonomous AI programs that can execute tasks independently, access tools (search, knowledge bases), communicate with other systems, and make decisions about task execution

nodes.label: AI Assistant
nodes.rationale: AI system with system prompt and persistent personality but limited autonomy; relies on user prompting; does not autonomously seek additional information

nodes.label: Context Window
nodes.rationale: Short-term memory of language models; GPT models up to 400k tokens, Claude models up to 1M tokens; effective use limited to ~50% of capacity before quality degrades

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Systems
nodes.rationale: Systems where multiple specialised AI agents collaborate in a pipeline; modular design improves reliability and scalability; failure of one agent does not stop the whole system

nodes.label: Deep Research (DeepSearch) Feature
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent research system in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and DeepSeek; uses reasoning decomposition, specialised search/evaluation/synthesis agents, and real-time thought process visualisation

nodes.label: Microsoft Copilot for Teams
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent system for MS Teams: speech-to-text, content analysis, meeting summary, task identification, and formatted note delivery; integrates with SharePoint, Planner, Jira, Asana

nodes.label: Open Agent Protocol (OAP)
nodes.rationale: Standard protocol for inter-agent communication across different vendors; enables agents from different companies to collaborate in e-commerce and business workflows

nodes.label: Team Navigator Application
nodes.rationale: Application using multi-agent pipeline to generate personalised reports based on Big Five personality questionnaire; agents handle data intake, classification, content generation, validation, and PDF rendering

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
nodes.rationale: Advanced prompting technique guiding model through explicit logical reasoning steps before final answer; zero-shot variant uses 'Let's think step by step'

nodes.label: Problem Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Breaking complex prompts into sequential sub-tasks so the model focuses on one aspect at a time; related to but distinct from chain-of-thought

nodes.label: Self-Refinement Prompting
nodes.rationale: Technique where the model evaluates and iteratively improves its own output; models like GPT-5, LLaMA-4, Claude-4 have native auto-reflection mechanisms

nodes.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
nodes.rationale: Architecture combining a Retriever (searches external knowledge bases) with a Generator (LLM); enables use of current/proprietary data and reduces hallucinations

nodes.label: Ensemble Prompting / Self-Consistency
nodes.rationale: Method of querying multiple models or the same model multiple times to get consensus answers; improves reliability in critical domains like medicine and law

nodes.label: AI Image Processing and Computer Vision
nodes.rationale: AI image processing covers edge detection, filtering, segmentation, deep learning with neural networks; applied in medicine, autonomous vehicles, manufacturing quality control, agriculture
nodes.norm_label: ai image processing and computer vision

nodes.label: No-Code / Low-Code AI Development
nodes.rationale: Platforms enabling AI application building without programming: Zapier, Make, N8N, Bubble, Langflow, Relevance AI, Wordware; democratises AI development for non-technical users

nodes.label: LangChain Framework
nodes.rationale: Popular Python/JavaScript framework for building LLM-based applications with chains and agents; Langflow provides a visual no-code layer on top of it

nodes.label: Machine Learning vs Generative AI Comparison
nodes.rationale: Comparative analysis: ML for precise defined problems with structured data; GenAI for complex multi-purpose tasks with unstructured data; complementary when combined
nodes.norm_label: machine learning vs generative ai comparison

nodes.label: Frontend React/TypeScript/Vite App
nodes.rationale: Minimal React + TypeScript application bootstrapped with Vite; entry point loads main.tsx module
